title: Geometry optimization and vibrational frequency calculation
action: Run MP2/6-311G(3df,2p) geometry optimization of formamide followed by a harmonic vibrational frequency and IR intensity calculation using an open-source quantum chemistry package (e.g., Psi4). Save the complete calculation output to a log file.
description: Complete calculation log from MP2/6-311G(3df,2p) optimization and frequency calculation.

title: Output optimized geometry
action: Extract the final optimized Cartesian coordinates from the calculation output and write them to an XYZ file.
description: XYZ file containing the optimized molecular geometry of formamide.
output_schema: Standard XYZ: first line number of atoms (6), second line comment, subsequent lines each with element symbol and x, y, z coordinates in Angstroms.

title: Molecular parameters (dipole, rotational constants)
action: Extract the dipole moment (in Debye) and the rotational constants A, B, C (in MHz) from the calculation output, and write them to a TSV file.
description: TSV file with two columns: property and value, containing the computed dipole moment and rotational constants.
output_schema: TSV with header 'property	value'. Rows: dipole_moment_D, A_MHz, B_MHz, C_MHz. Values are floats.

title: Harmonic vibrational data (unscaled wavenumbers and intensities)
action: Extract the unscaled harmonic vibrational wavenumbers (cm⁻¹) and absolute IR intensities (km mol⁻¹) for all 12 normal modes from the calculation output, and write them to a TSV file.
description: TSV file with unscaled harmonic data for the 12 normal modes of formamide.
output_schema: TSV with header 'mode_index	wavenumber_cm1	intensity_km_mol'. mode_index is an integer from 1 to 12; wavenumber_cm1 and intensity_km_mol are floats.
